...
mobility strategy with your business objectives
...
## A geographically-diverse workforce brings opportunities
...
Employee mobility is increasingly central to strategy and talent development. Businesses are supplementing or even replacing traditional assignment models with more diverse and complex solutions, such as hybrid and remote working.
...
## Why Grant Thornton
...
You'll be supported by a team with deep technical capabilities and access to a global network across 130 countries.
...
We take the time to understand what's important to you and to build our delivery model around you and your business. Our agile approach can be applied to the most complex projects
...
## Your business and mobile employees can receive support in these areas:
...
### Strategic assignment-planning, advice, and support
...
From advice on tax-efficient assignment planning through to wider policy development and review, we ensure that your mobility strategy supports your wider business needs and your employee value proposition. You can also receive support on budgeting, cost management, and review of your return on investment.
...
### Tax and payroll compliance services
...
You can request home and host-tax briefings, tax compliance support, and shadow/modified payroll services in over 130 locations across our network.
...
### Non-resident directors
...
Your executive and non-executive/non-resident directors can benefit from specialist guidance, including residency and social security planning, treatment of directors' fees and other remuneration arrangements, and payroll.
...
planning and compliance services
...
Advice is available on policy-and-process implementation, as well as identifying key risk areas and the potential for cost reduction. Our services include application and reporting for modified NIC schemes, Certificate of Coverage/A1 applications and Posted Worker advice, and notifications in Europe.
...
### Short-term business travellers, commuters and remote workers
...
The ability for employees to work effectively away from the office has increased the potential for remote international postings, adding another layer of complexity. Gap analysis can help you optimise all aspects of your current operational model: from process design for managing the population, and tracking, reporting and analysis through PinPoint calendar technology.
...
### International pension tax arrangements for employers, executives and trustees
...
Pension provision is a significant part of the overall reward proposition. We can support you with cross-border taxation of retirement plans, including establishment of plans, taxation of contributions, pension plan distributions and global compliance.
...
### Understanding global mobility challenges with Katy Bond
...
Hear from Katy Bond as she discusses the main challenges businesses face in global mobility, including international remote working, short-term business travel, and ad hoc mobility arrangements.
...
## International contractors and IR35
...
It's crucial to know the IR35 status, and potential tax implications, of all your contractors – wherever they're based.

sources.title: Tom Nokes
sources.snippet: Tom Nokes is Head of Sales at The PSSG. Previously worked at Cintra HR & Payroll Services (Head of Sales - 3y 4m), Capture Expense (Head of Sales - 2y), Logicalis UK&I (UK Sales Director - 4m) and 8 more. Based in London, England, United Kingdom. Studied BA (Hons) Marketing Management at Northumbria University
